title: 19th-century Baron Trump time-travel books

tellings.quote: Dawn and Baron Trump and their time traveling adventures, which is a book that was written, I think, also in the 19th century.
Um, you have the adventures of Baron and Donald Trump, you know, in the 1890s,
tellings.difference: Dates the books to the 1890s specifically.
tellings.link_reason: The same 19th-century Baron Trump books, told by the same host.

plain: In the 1800s, there were books called The Adventures of Baron Trump about a boy named Baron Trump and his time-traveling adventures with a figure Michels calls Don. Michels brings them up himself, without naming a source. He first places them vaguely in the 19th century, and in a later episode he dates them to the 1890s, pointing to the names as an odd echo of Donald Trump and his son Barron.
